The rabbit travels approximately 204 px in 2.3 s. Converting with the antelope-derived scale gives its speed.
The rabbit is approximately 27 px tall, including its ears; the motion-derived scale is 0.0148 m/px.
The rabbit's horizontal extent is approximately 30.5 px; multiplying by 0.0148 m/px gives its length.
